thread:
priya: Revenue flagged ACME pilot asking for an "elastic seats" add-on — autoscaling seats + temporary burst during demo week. Can product confirm scope?

matt: Quick Q — is ACME asking for per-seat billing or concurrent-seat enforcement?

priya: They prefer per-seat billed monthly but want seats to auto-provision up to 10 extra for spikes, billed as overage credits. Wants rollout in 2 weeks for demo.

elaine: We need clear launch criteria: pricing for base seats, overage rate, UI surface to opt-in, and telemetry for seat usage. Also guardrails so customers can't exceed total GPU quota.

andrew: Engineering: how strict is enforcement? We can implement a soft-limit flow that issues warnings + throttle after grace window. Hard limit will need quota service changes.

priya: Soft-limit is acceptable for pilot, but commercial launch must have hard enforcement option. For pilot ACME, soft-limit + invoice reconciliation OK.

matt: Finance: what's target ARPA delta? Need to know if this becomes a new SKU or an add-on in existing tiers.

elaine: Proposal: product ship as 'Elastic Seats' add-on SKU. Pilot: no upfront commit, usage billed at 1.6x base seat price for overage credits. Launch criteria: 2 pilots, billing path validated, docs + console UX, legal approved contract clause.

legalbot: Contract note: must include explicit maximum seat cap, audit right, and overage billing terms. Avoid open-ended language. Suggest clause: "Customer may provision up to N Add-On Seats; usage beyond will be billed at stated overage rate and subject to audit." 

andrew: Implementation sketch:
```
// seat config example
{ "base_seats": 20, "elastic_max": 30, "overage_rate": "1.6x" }
```
We need backend quota check + billing event on seat provision.

matt: UX: add toggle in Team -> Seats: [Enable Elastic Seats] with slider for "max extra seats" and a link to billing preview.

priya: Ops concern: Need monitoring dashboards for seat provisioning per-org, spike alerts, and auto-throttle policy if total GPU capacity used > 85%.

andrew: Ops + Eng can scope telemetry in next sprint. Can we deprioritize hard-limit enforcement until after pilot? 

elaine: Yes but require rollout runway doc and rollback plan. Owner: @priya. Eng owner: @andrew. Legal: @legalbot. Finance: @matt.

priya: Action items: 1) Product write spec PR by EOD Tue. 2) Eng spike for quota + billing events Wed. 3) Legal draft clause Thu. 4) UX mockups Fri. If any blockers call a quick sync.

matt: :thumbsup:

andrew: Will start spike, tagging eng-infra for quota changes. 

priya: Thanks team — putting this on the roadmap board under Q2 pilot add-ons.
